organization.name: GravityCart
organization.description: GravityCart is an automotive-engineered gravity cart — dimensioned tolerances, proven brake components and mono-material recyclability, convertible between wheels and skis in under five minutes.

products.name: GravityCart JM-001 — All-Season Chassis
products.description: The complete automotive-engineered gravity cart: forged fork and dual-piston brake calipers, shipped with the wheel assembly mounted. Converts to the winter ski assembly in under five minutes.

products.name: Wheel Assembly — Summer Kit
products.description: Forged-aluminum wheel assembly with dual-piston brake calipers for warm-weather descents. Bolts to the JM-001 chassis mount point in under five minutes.

products.name: Ski Assembly — Winter Kit
products.description: CNC-milled ski assembly for snow and ice descents, interchanging with the wheel assembly at the identical chassis mount point.

products.name: Precision Maintenance Kit
products.description: Brake fluid, sealed bearing grease and torque-spec hardware for seasonal chassis conversion and routine upkeep.

faq.q: What's included in the Precision Maintenance Kit?
faq.a: Brake fluid, sealed bearing grease and torque-spec hardware for seasonal chassis conversion and routine upkeep — priced at €129.

faq.q: How long does it take to switch between wheels and skis?
faq.a: Under five minutes. The wheel assembly and ski assembly bolt to the identical chassis mount point, so one JM-001 frame covers both summer and winter riding without buying a second frame.

faq.q: What is the fork made from?
faq.a: A forged fork, built to automotive-tolerance geometry and shared across both the wheel and ski configurations, so steering feel stays identical between seasons.
Dual-piston Shimano hydraulic disc brakes — the same braking hardware proven on downhill mountain bikes for a decade, not a prototype component developed for marketing.

faq.q: What does a complete GravityCart setup cost?
faq.a: The JM-001 All-Season Chassis is €3,499 and ships with the wheel assembly mounted. Add the Ski Assembly Winter Kit for €799, or buy the Wheel Assembly Summer Kit on its own for €899. A Precision Maintenance Kit for seasonal conversion and upkeep is €129.
